Tara Brooks: Quick flag — during yesterday's canary some route cards went to 0. Product asked why cost vanished.
Evan Cho: Which metric? per-route marginal-cost or total-burn?
Tara Brooks: marginal-cost column on the Cost Overview. It flips to 0 when router prefers prefetch-variant B.
Kim Alvarez: We have a rule in econ-ingest that drops unit_cost when request is marked prefetch_replay to avoid double-counting. That leads to SUM(tokens * unit_cost) = 0.
Evan Cho: Hm. Hiding cost is worse than approximate cost. Users should see net vs gross.
Tara Brooks: Suggestion: add fields in econ_event v2 => route_variant, effective_unit_cost, credit_reason, sampling_rate, sample_count. Default dashboards show net (post-credit) but allow "Show gross" toggle.
Kim Alvarez: Implementation detail: emit effective_unit_cost = IF(prefetch_replay, amortized_unit_cost, unit_cost) and credit_reason = one of ("prefetch_hit","prefetch_replay","router_fallback").
Evan Cho: Consumers should compute cost as tokens * COALESCE(effective_unit_cost, unit_cost) to be backward compatible.
Tara Brooks: UX: when sample_count < 75 show small banner "Estimate noisy — low sample (N)" and gray the sparkline. Hover shows sampling_rate and credit_reason breakdown.
Kim Alvarez: SQL sketch we plan to use: ```SELECT route, route_variant, SUM(tokens) AS tokens, SUM(tokens * COALESCE(effective_unit_cost, unit_cost)) AS net_cost, SUM(tokens * unit_cost) AS gross_cost, AVG(sampling_rate) AS sampling_rate, SUM(sample_count) AS sample_count FROM econ_events WHERE ts BETWEEN $start AND $end GROUP BY route, route_variant;```
Evan Cho: Also export credit_reason counts so teams can see how much cost is "credited" vs real routing degradation.
Tara Brooks: Rollout plan: proto bump -> ingest rollout -> consumers opt-in -> dashboard feature-flag -> canary. Owners?
Kim Alvarez: I'll open proto PR today with migration notes. ETA: PR by EOD.
Evan Cho: I'll own consumer adapters and reconciliation job to diff old vs new aggregates. Need raw-events retention = 30d during rollout.
metrics-bot: metrics-bot: Retention override applied: econ-raw = 30d for rollout namespaces.
Tara Brooks: I'll implement the dashboard query change + the toggle + low-sample UX; will put a mockup in Figma and link here.
Evan Cho: Ops: please schedule canary with feature flag `econ_v2_cost_fields` once proto merges.
metrics-bot: metrics-bot: Canary scheduled: cost-ingest-v2 -> cluster-canary at 2024-07-14T02:00Z (flag: econ_v2_cost_fields).
Kim Alvarez: Note for downstream teams: use COALESCE semantics and respect sampling_rate. Add a short migration guide in PR.
Tara Brooks: Action items listed: Kim PR, Evan reconciler + retention, Tara dashboard + mockup. We'll re-check after canary.
Evan Cho: Thanks — want to avoid any surprise "zero cost" tickets from customers.
Tara Brooks: Agreed. Posting mockup and PR links shortly.
Evan Cho: :thumbsup:
